description: This file contains unit tests for poll-related functions including parsing, building poll content, relation handling, and result summarization. It uses the 'vitest' testing framework to verify the correctness of poll processing logic within the project.

methods.name: parsePollStartContent
methods.description: Parses legacy and current poll start content payloads to extract question, answers, and max selection limits.

methods.name: parsePollStart
methods.description: Parses raw poll start data, preserving answer IDs and adjusting max selections within valid bounds.

methods.name: buildPollStartContent
methods.description: Constructs the payload for starting a poll with specified question, options, and max selections.

methods.name: buildPollResponseContent
methods.description: Builds a poll response payload referencing a poll event ID with selected answers.

methods.name: parsePollResponseAnswerIds
methods.description: Extracts answer IDs from poll response events, supporting multiple answer formats.

methods.name: resolvePollReferenceEventId
methods.description: Extracts the event ID of the poll reference from a relation event.

methods.name: buildPollResultsSummary
methods.description: Aggregates votes, considering only the latest response per sender, to produce a poll results summary.

methods.name: formatPollResultsAsText
methods.description: Formats the poll results into a human-readable text summary including vote counts.
